title: dissectors: Remove init of hf and ett variable arrays
description:
Manually remove init of hf and ett variable arrays because this
cannot be easily done using the convert script.

notes.body:
Pre-commit check results:
  ~~~
  ERROR: NO ARRAY: epan/dissectors/packet-iso8583.c: hf_iso8583_data_bit
  ~~~
This is `checkhf.py` which doesn't know how the array is used. I'll revert this rename for now.
